assets.name: 余烬·射手
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original SAGITTARIUS zodiac bow concept for Skyrim solid-light weapons. Create ONE single complete upright bow, limbs curve LEFT and single taut thin straight bowstring on RIGHT, full upper/lower tips visible with margins, portrait 2:3 black studio background. Elegant cohesive geometric fantasy silhouette built entirely from substantial broad faceted luminous planes and sweeping flat solid-light ribbons, not thin wires, no normal metallic hardware, leather or wood. Saturated readable colored surfaces with crisp brighter beveled edges and restrained soft glow; avoid white burnout. A comfortable continuous one-hand grip physically joins both limb shoulders; negative spaces clearly distinguish grip, limbs and string. Sagittarius expressed abstractly through arrowhead-like swept planes, aerodynamic fletching geometry and the trajectory of a shooting star. No literal centaur, animal sculptures, engraved zodiac symbols, hexagrams, separate arrows, humans or hands, captions, watermarks, or gigantic magic circles. Sharp beautiful designed weapon, not a cluster of detached decorations. Small sparse luminous particles close to limbs as VFX concept, not obscuring geometry. Top and bottom visually balanced. Each bow should have distinct grip and silhouette. Palette ruby red/crimson, bright rose rims with subtle scarlet highlights, no orange or gold. Design: CRIMSON VECTOR. Central short waisted faceted grip, shoulders open into compact long triangular arrowhead cutouts seamlessly swept into the limbs. Each limb consists of THREE long overlapping saber-shaped arrow-fletching planes, progressively longer toward the outer curve, broad surfaces taper into sharp tips; these are three large smooth forms, not many feather scales. Slender inner supporting arc joins all planes into one deep recurved bow, clean black slits between them. Both limb tips are slim elongated spearheads pointing along the bow's curve. Bold graceful arrowhead rhythm with a single restrained chevron collar on each end of the grip. Small red needle sparks and rose triangular flakes flow locally near the blade roots.
